statement: Generalize the formation readiness primitive from 'has the operation ledger got off the seed?' to 'has the critical system-table set reached its required serving topology?': a single observer projects critical-placement convergence from the system-table cache and the formation barrier reports it as typed evidence. This slice observes and proves; making it a hard prerequisite for initial TRAFFIC_READY is the next slice, because a joiner that waited on spread it must itself supply would deadlock formation.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The distinct-voting-node invariant keeps its single owner in critical-placement-convergence.js. This observer owns exactly one thing — reading the serving rows out of the system-table cache — and delegates every judgement to that evaluator; it re-derives no replication factor, no critical set and no convergence rule.

The formation barrier reports the observation and MUST NOT gate its release on it. A joiner that waited for spread which only its own join can supply would deadlock formation; the lifecycle owner consumes this evidence in a later slice. The sealed release condition stays the startup-authority answer, pinned by a control.
A cache that cannot answer is a distinct typed outcome and is never convergence; absent evidence is never read as satisfaction.

The observation is frozen, carries exactly state, converged, pendingPartitionIds and observedPartitionCount, mints no readiness phase, releases no barrier, and derives nothing from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.

Proof is a deterministic node:test witness over cache fixtures, with barrier-release-is-unchanged-by-the-observation as the control that must stay green; every guard is mutation-verified with a harness that asserts the patch anchor is unique, and no cloud run is part of the proof.
